_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision this sim/ tree's committed evidence records were generated against. Every record under sim/*/records/ must trace to this file (or a later commit that bumps it) -- see sim/README.md 'PDK pin' section. sim/pdk-smoke/run_smoke.sh reads release_tag from here. The OpenVAF-Reloaded compiler pin lives only in sim/harness/common/tools/build-osdi.sh (OPENVAF_TAG).
fetch_method: klayout-tools scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh (2AMLogic/klayout-tools), same fetch this repo's design/README.md documents for schematic-entry work
pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2 (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention)

documented_tool_versions_from_pdk_versio.note: This PDK release's own versions.txt names openvaf 23.5.0 as the tool used to build its Verilog-A device models to OSDI. That upstream release ships source only (no binary assets), so this repo builds the same models with the PDK-preferred OpenVAF-Reloaded fork instead -- see sim/harness/common/tools/build-osdi.sh and sim/README.md 'OSDI device models'.
